description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework that monitors system states and exposes an API for clients to query and listen to state changes. It manages property registration, state retrieval, event handling, and notifications for various system parameters such as system time, network info, and device status.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: Main class implementing the StateObserver plugin that handles registration, property monitoring, event processing, and API interactions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers event handlers via IARM.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves current values for specified properties from the system.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers property names for monitoring and notifications.

methods.name: onReportStateObserverEvents
methods.description: Event handler invoked when system state changes occur; updates internal state and notifies subscribers.
